title: DEMETHYL-03 non-cognate docking in the 1KZK JE2 pocket
scientific_question: Can the single MOLDISC-009-selected DEMETHYL-03 analog execute reproducibly through the already operational 1KZK receptor-preparation and native-pocket Vina protocol under the existing non-cognate holo cross-docking capability boundary?

docking.grid_rule: derive from exact crystallographic JE2 reference coordinates using research-os.redocking.v1.1 native-ligand box rule
docking.receptor_rule: reuse REDOCK-003 ATX-007 receptor extraction: protein ATOM records from author chains A+B

primary_endpoint.name: technical completion under frozen non-cognate JE2-pocket protocol
primary_endpoint.pass_condition: non-empty receptor and ligand PDBQT, Vina 1.2.7 return code zero, at least one finite non-zero scored pose, complete provenance

interpretation_boundaries: MOLDISC-010 docks exactly one candidate already selected by MOLDISC-009 and performs no candidate selection.
The receptor/grid protocol is reused from the operational REDOCK-003 ATX-007 context and is not tuned to DEMETHYL-03.
A Vina score is E2 computational evidence and is not measured affinity, potency or free energy.
No RMSD to native JE2 is reported because DEMETHYL-03 and JE2 are different molecular graphs.
NON_COGNATE_HOLO_CROSSDOCKING remains PARTIALLY_VALIDATED under the existing capability profile.
Technical completion does not establish a correct binding pose, protease inhibition, potency, efficacy, safety or clinical utility.
Candidate identity, grid derivation and Vina settings may not be changed in response to the first observed docking score.
